integrity: Exact finite arithmetic and deterministic nested-formula checks support the analytic all-dimensions proof; computations are not an infinite proof. Scientific self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Single-agent Boolean non-contingency with a fixed positive finite number of atoms, interpreted over all serial, transitive, Euclidean Kripke frames. Does not address multi-agent fragments or primitive necessity. Earlier algebraic priority under other terminology remains possible.
title: Exact semantic quotient and sharp model bound for non-contingency over KD45
